content: ⌊ DRAFT g If NmPnEiraCalcEnabled is TRUE and the stored value for a PNC is set to PNC requested or back to PNC released (see [SWS_Nm_00313], [SWS_Nm_00314] and [SWS_Nm_00320]), then Nm shall forward the changed state of EIRA to ComM by calling ComM_Nm_UpdateEIRA (<PncBitVector of EIRA>)) .

If NmPnEiraCalcEnabled is TRUE and the stored value for a PNC is set to PNC requested or back to PNC released (see [SWS_Nm_00313] and [SWS_Nm_00320]), then Nm shall forward the changed state of EIRA to ComM by calling ComM_Nm_UpdateEIRA(<PncBitVector of EIRA>)) .
